weaponBlueprint.name: hullsmash2

weaponBlueprint.name: vulcan

weaponBlueprint.name: chargers

weaponBlueprint.name: hullbeam
weaponBlueprint.title: Hull Beam

weaponBlueprint.name: halberd
weaponBlueprint.title: Halberd Beam
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Slow but reliably powerful standard beam weapon.

weaponBlueprint.name: glaive
weaponBlueprint.title: Glaive Beam
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: One of the most powerful weapons of war ever created. Known to take out some ships in a single blast.

weaponBlueprint.name: firebeam
weaponBlueprint.title: Fire Beam
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: This terrifying beam does no physical damage but ignites fires.

weaponBlueprint.name: antibio

weaponBlueprint.tooltip: This terrifying beam does no physical damage, but rips through organic material, dealing heavy damage to crew members.

weaponBlueprint.name: ioncharger

weaponBlueprint.tooltip: This ion weapon can charge multiple times, giving it additional projectiles.

weaponBlueprint.name: chainion
weaponBlueprint.title: Chain Ion
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: This weapon's Ion damage increases each time it fires to a max of 4.

weaponBlueprint.name: bossion
weaponBlueprint.title: Boss Ion
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Flagship artillery. Three shots of one ion. Not sold.

weaponBlueprint.name: hermes
weaponBlueprint.title: Hermes Missile
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Standard but powerful missile.

weaponBlueprint.name: breachmissiles
weaponBlueprint.title: Breach Missiles
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: These missiles are designed to cause maximum destruction to ship hull armor.

weaponBlueprint.name: hullmissile
weaponBlueprint.title: Hull Missile
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: High hull damage plus a decent breach chance.

weaponBlueprint.name: swarmmissiles
weaponBlueprint.title: Swarm Missiles
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: If given time to prepare, the 'Swarm' launcher can replicate multiple warheads.

weaponBlueprint.name: pegasus
weaponBlueprint.title: Pegasus Missile
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Creative missile design allows for two projectiles for the cost of one!

weaponBlueprint.name: smallbomb
weaponBlueprint.title: Small Bomb
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Self-teleporting explosive that damages systems and crew but not the hull. Can target your own ship.

weaponBlueprint.name: breach1
weaponBlueprint.title: Breach Bomb Mark I
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Self-teleporting explosive designed to damage systems and causes a breach. Can target your own ship.

weaponBlueprint.name: breach2
weaponBlueprint.title: Breach Bomb Mark II
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Slower than Mark 1 but breaches and does more damage to systems. Can target your own ship.

weaponBlueprint.name: ionbomb
weaponBlueprint.title: Ion Bomb
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Self-teleporting explosive that uses ion damage to disable systems. Can target your own ship.

weaponBlueprint.name: stunbomb
weaponBlueprint.title: Stun Bomb
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Self-teleporting explosive that does 1 ion damage and stuns all crew inside the room. Can target your own ship.

weaponBlueprint.name: healburst
weaponBlueprint.title: Healing Burst
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Self-teleporting healing unit that instantly heals all friendly crew in the room. Can target your own ship.

weaponBlueprint.name: repairburst
weaponBlueprint.title: Repair Burst
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Self-teleporting unit that floods a room with nano-bots capable of completely repairing all system damage.

weaponBlueprint.name: lockdown
weaponBlueprint.title: Crystal Lockdown Bomb
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Self-teleporting explosive that does no damage but creates a dense wall preventing movement in or out of the room. Can target your own ship.

weaponBlueprint.name: advflak
weaponBlueprint.title: Adv. Flak Gun
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Fires a blast of debris across a random area doing up to 3 damage. Good at taking down shields but hard to aim.

weaponBlueprint.name: flak2
weaponBlueprint.title: Flak Gun Mark II
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Fires a blast of debris across a random area doing up to 7 damage. Good at taking down shields but hard to aim.

weaponBlueprint.name: crystalburst

weaponBlueprint.name: crystalburst2

weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Modified projectile weapon that fires shield piercing crystals.

weaponBlueprint.title: Heavy Crystal Mark II
weaponBlueprint.tooltip: Modified projectile weapon that fires shield piercing crystals.

augBlueprint.name: echo

augBlueprint.desc: A missile has a 50% chance not to be spent.

augBlueprint.name: quiet
augBlueprint.title: Stealth Weapons
augBlueprint.desc: Firing does not drop cloaking.

augBlueprint.name: hot
augBlueprint.title: Weapon Pre-Igniter
augBlueprint.desc: After a jump, enabled weapons that have power start fully charged.

augBlueprint.name: weld
augBlueprint.title: Repair Arm
augBlueprint.desc: Scrap gain repairs 2 hull and is cut 15% while the hull is not already full.

augBlueprint.name: baffle
augBlueprint.title: Reverse Ion Field
augBlueprint.desc: 50% chance to ignore an ion hit. Two or more ignore every ion hit.

augBlueprint.name: coil
augBlueprint.title: Shield Charge Booster
augBlueprint.desc: Shields recharge 15% faster per copy.

augBlueprint.name: spool
augBlueprint.title: FTL Recharge Booster
augBlueprint.desc: One copy makes FTL charge take 80% as long. Two take 67%. Three take 57%.

augBlueprint.name: hook
augBlueprint.title: Scrap Recovery Arm

augBlueprint.name: keel

augBlueprint.name: casing
augBlueprint.title: Titanium System Casing

augBlueprint.name: tap

augBlueprint.name: lung
augBlueprint.title: Emergency Respirators

augBlueprint.name: squall
augBlueprint.title: Fire Suppression

augBlueprint.name: falsebuoy
augBlueprint.title: Distraction Buoys

augBlueprint.name: glass
augBlueprint.title: Long-Ranged Scanners

augBlueprint.name: jammer

augBlueprint.desc: Enemy ships take twice as long to charge FTL.

augBlueprint.name: recover
augBlueprint.title: Drone Recovery Arm

augBlueprint.name: stun

augBlueprint.desc: Everyone in a room during a hacking pulse is stunned for that pulse.

augBlueprint.name: dna

augBlueprint.name: mend
augBlueprint.title: Reconstructive Teleport
augBlueprint.desc: A person sent through the teleporter is fully healed.

augBlueprint.name: pulseeye
augBlueprint.title: Lifeform Scanner
augBlueprint.desc: Living crew show up even when sensors do not.

augBlueprint.name: nav
augBlueprint.title: Adv. FTL Navigation
augBlueprint.desc: The ship can jump to any previously visited beacon, including beacons later overtaken by the Rebel Fleet.

augBlueprint.name: scrambler
augBlueprint.title: Defense Scrambler
augBlueprint.desc: Enemy Defense Drone I, Defense Drone II, and Anti-Combat drones cannot acquire or shoot down targets. Your own defense drones still fire.

augBlueprint.name: bypass
augBlueprint.title: Zoltan Shield Bypass
augBlueprint.desc: Crew teleportation, bomb teleportation, and mind control work through Zoltan Shields.

shipBlueprint.name: kestrel-a
shipBlueprint.title: The Kestrel
shipBlueprint.desc: This class of ship was decommissioned from Federation service years ago. After a number of refits and updating, this classic ship is ready for battle.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Available from the start. It is the only layout that does not need an unlock.

shipBlueprint.name: kestrel-b
shipBlueprint.title: Red-Tail
shipBlueprint.desc: This modified Kestrel class ship was created by a laser weapon aficionado.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earn at least two of the three Kestrel Cruiser achievements.

shipBlueprint.name: kestrel-c
shipBlueprint.title: The Swallow
shipBlueprint.desc: This model was modified by pirates to utilize newly discovered technology. It can clone lost crewmembers and stun enemies.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reach the final sector with Kestrel layout B, Advanced Edition on.

shipBlueprint.name: engi-a
shipBlueprint.title: The Torus
shipBlueprint.desc: Although it may look like a pile of junk loosely held together, this well designed ship relies on drones and ion weaponry.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reach sector 5 with any Kestrel layout.

shipBlueprint.name: engi-b
shipBlueprint.title: The Vortex
shipBlueprint.desc: Heavily understaffed, this ship relies on drones to keep the ship running.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earn at least two of the three Engi Cruiser achievements.

shipBlueprint.name: engi-c
shipBlueprint.title: Tetragon
shipBlueprint.desc: The Engi were quick to adapt to the sudden surge of hacking technology — this ship is the result of their research.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reach the final sector with Engi layout B, Advanced Edition on.

shipBlueprint.name: fed-a
shipBlueprint.title: The Osprey
shipBlueprint.desc: This ship features the latest in federation technology: an advanced beam weapon that pierces through shields!
shipBlueprint.unlock: Defeat the Flagship prototype in the Rebel Stronghold sector, or defeat the Rebel Flagship with the Engi Cruiser.

shipBlueprint.name: fed-b
shipBlueprint.title: Nisos
shipBlueprint.desc: This ship features additional Artillery power, encouraging heavy reliance on the beam.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earn two of the three Federation Cruiser achievements.

shipBlueprint.name: fed-c
shipBlueprint.title: The Fregatidae
shipBlueprint.desc: With a Flak Artillery weapon and an improved Clone Bay, only the most suicidal of infantry chooses to fly on this ship.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reach sector 8 with Federation layout B, Advanced Edition on.

shipBlueprint.name: zoltan-a
shipBlueprint.title: The Adjudicator
shipBlueprint.desc: The Zoltan's advanced shields technology give this ship an edge during each battle.
shipBlueprint.unlock: See the Unarmed Zoltan Transport, or defeat the Flagship with the Federation Cruiser.

shipBlueprint.name: zoltan-b
shipBlueprint.title: Noether
shipBlueprint.desc: This ship starts with a weakened Shield system and must rely on its Zoltan shield.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earn two of the three Zoltan Cruiser achievements.

shipBlueprint.name: zoltan-c
shipBlueprint.title: Cerenkov
shipBlueprint.desc: The designer of this ship was not willing to spend the money for a decent reactor. Instead it relies on its Zoltan crew and Backup Battery.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reach sector 8 with Zoltan layout B, Advanced Edition on.

shipBlueprint.name: slug-a
shipBlueprint.title: Man of War
shipBlueprint.desc: Designed for use inside nebula, this cruiser lacks sensors and relies instead on the guile and cunning of the Slugs.
shipBlueprint.unlock: See the Slug Home Nebula Surrender event, or defeat the Flagship with the Mantis Cruiser.

shipBlueprint.name: slug-b
shipBlueprint.title: The Stormwalker
shipBlueprint.desc: This boarding ship has no medical facilities and must manage its explosives carefully to keep the crew alive.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earn two of the three Slug Cruiser achievements.

shipBlueprint.name: slug-c
shipBlueprint.title: Ariolimax
shipBlueprint.desc: Slugs are often skilled in the arts of misdirection and manipulation. With Hacking and Mind Control systems, this ship capitalizes on that fact.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reach sector 8 with Slug layout B, Advanced Edition on.

shipBlueprint.name: rock-a
shipBlueprint.title: Bulwark
shipBlueprint.desc: Similar to its designers, this super dense behemoth uses brute force to overwhelm its foes.
shipBlueprint.unlock: See the Rock war vessel encounter, or defeat the Flagship with the Slug Cruiser.

shipBlueprint.name: rock-b
shipBlueprint.title: Shivan
shipBlueprint.desc: With no airlocks, this ship must rely entirely on its rock crew to put out fires.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earn two of the three Rock Cruiser achievements.

shipBlueprint.name: rock-c
shipBlueprint.title: Tektite
shipBlueprint.desc: Contact has been made with the Crystalline race and this cruiser was offered to the Federation as part of diplomatic discussions between the sister species.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reach sector 8 with Rock layout B, Advanced Edition on.

shipBlueprint.name: stealth-a
shipBlueprint.title: The Nesasio
shipBlueprint.desc: Constructed for the Federation by the Engi, this ship is designed to use cloaking technology and speed to get behind enemy lines.
shipBlueprint.unlock: See the Engi fleet discussion event, or defeat the Flagship with the Rock Cruiser.

shipBlueprint.name: stealth-b
shipBlueprint.title: DA-SR 12
shipBlueprint.desc: Built like a glass cannon, this ship is hard to handle. If its cloaking can keep it safe long enough to charge its weapon, few cruisers can withstand its might.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earn two of the three Stealth Cruiser achievements.

shipBlueprint.name: stealth-c
shipBlueprint.title: Simo-H
shipBlueprint.desc: This ship was part of an Engi experiment to make a power efficient version of the Zoltan shield. Unfortunately this required the removal of the Cloaking system.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reach sector 8 with Stealth layout B, Advanced Edition on.

shipBlueprint.name: lanius-a
shipBlueprint.title: Kruos
shipBlueprint.desc: The sharp knife-like structures make Lanius ships a sight to behold. This cruiser was adapted to support the other races of the Federation.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Unlock 4 ships besides The Kestrel.

shipBlueprint.name: lanius-b
shipBlueprint.title: The Shrike
shipBlueprint.desc: The racial ability of the Lanius make them fearsome combatants in small quarters. Combine that with a Mind Control system and this ship is a force to be reckoned with.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earn two of the three Lanius Cruiser achievements.

shipBlueprint.name: mantis-a
shipBlueprint.title: The Gila Monster
shipBlueprint.desc: This warship is designed to enhance its crew for close combat missions.
shipBlueprint.unlock: See the Legendary Thief KazaaakplethKilik random event. Alternatively, defeat the Rebel Flagship with the Zoltan Cruiser.

shipBlueprint.name: mantis-b
shipBlueprint.title: The Basilisk
shipBlueprint.desc: This warship encourages sending massive boarding parties and keeping strong defense.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earning two of the three Mantis Cruiser achievements will unlock Layout B.

shipBlueprint.name: mantis-c
shipBlueprint.title: The Theseus
shipBlueprint.desc: With a large teleporter and weapons designed to impede enemy crew, this ship is deadly in the hands of a capable boarding party.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Reaching Sector 8 with the Mantis Cruiser B and Advanced Edition Content enabled will unlock layout C.

shipBlueprint.name: crystal-a
shipBlueprint.title: Bravais
shipBlueprint.desc: This powerful vessel is powered by the secret technologies of the lost Crystalline Beings.
shipBlueprint.unlock: See Ancestry (ship achievement) and its linked pages for directions on unlocking the Crystal Cruiser. Alternatively, beat the Flagship with layout A and B of every ship (excluding The Lanius Cruiser).

shipBlueprint.name: crystal-b
shipBlueprint.title: Carnelian
shipBlueprint.desc: Their unique racial ability makes the Crystal beings very adept at ship boarding. This ship was designed for such raiding parties.
shipBlueprint.unlock: Earn at least two out of three achievements for the Crystal Cruiser.

sectorDescription.name: civilian-start
sectorDescription.title: Civilian (Starting) Sector
sectorDescription.note: Always and only sector 1. It is not the usual Civilian Sector: fewer stores, items, quests, and nebulas.
The beacon list gives 1-2 stores, 1 quests event, and 0-4 nebula beacons.
Crew bought or received as a crew-kill reward, common to rare: Human rarity 1, Engi and Mantis 2, Rockmen 3, Zoltan 5. Rarity only affects store assortment probability.

Crew bought or received as a crew-kill reward, common to rare: Slug and Human rarity 2, Engi, Mantis, Zoltan, and Rockmen 4. Rarity only affects store assortment probability.

sectorDescription.title: Hidden Crystal Worlds
sectorDescription.note: Only once per game, and only through the Ancient device event. It is not technically part of the map.
It is a standalone sector, separate from Rock Homeworlds. The Rebels keep following you through it.
Exiting sends you to a random sector after the Rock Homeworlds. That next sector may not be connected to the Rock Homeworlds.
Stores and crew-kill rewards offer only crystal weapons, including the Lockdown Bomb. Only Crystal crew can be bought or received as a crew-kill reward.
The beacon list gives 2-3 stores.
Restarting while still in this sector drops the run into a Civilian sector. The exit will not open the sector map, so sector 2 is chosen at random.

sectorDescription.name: last-stand
sectorDescription.title: The Last Stand
sectorDescription.note: Always sector 8. As the final sector, it occurs only once.
At the start the ship receives 10 repairs and 10 fuel.
The Rebel Flagship spawns on the right and jumps every two jumps you make. A dotted or solid line shows whether it jumps this turn. Sharing its beacon starts the fight.
The Rebel Fleet does not advance from the left. It overtakes random beacons each turn, marked by flashing red outlines. The Flagship also overtakes the beacon it is on.
The Federation base sits slightly right of centre, and the Flagship jumps toward it. 3 consecutive jumps on the base lose the game.
The base is never overtaken. If the Flagship is forced off, it returns to Federation control. The base acts like an empty beacon.
Waiting is allowed even with fuel, and it advances the Flagship and the flashing beacons. A fight after a wait starts with full FTL charge.
Each repair beacon gives 15 repairs, 22-44 scrap, 5 fuel, 4 missiles, and 5 drones. Each can be used once, and it may be overtaken before you arrive.
The beacon list gives 1 store and 3 repair stations.
Crew bought or received as a reward, common to rare: Human rarity 1, Engi and Mantis 2, Rockmen 3, Zoltan 5. Rarity only affects store assortment probability.

eventBlueprint.name: auto-ship-attacking-civilian

eventBlueprint.text: You come across a Rebel automated scout ship pursuing a civilian ship, weapons engaged.

eventBlueprint.name: auto-ship-attacking-outpost

eventBlueprint.text: You detect an automated Rebel scout attacking a small refueling outpost.

eventBlueprint.name: auto-ship-carrying-shield-virus
eventBlueprint.title: Auto-ship carrying shield virus
eventBlueprint.text: Your arrival is greeted by numerous computer alerts. The nearby automated Rebel scout has deployed a virus and disrupted your shield system. Hopefully it won't cause further problems before you can destroy it.

eventBlueprint.name: auto-ship-fight-crystal
eventBlueprint.title: Auto-ship fight (Crystal)
eventBlueprint.text: The Rebels must have sent their automated scouts to find you. One jumps in and immediately moves to attack.

eventBlueprint.name: auto-ship-fight-in-asteroid-field
eventBlueprint.title: Auto-ship fight in asteroid field
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive in an asteroid belt to discover that a Rebel automated-scout has been stationed here. Prepare for a fight!

eventBlueprint.name: auto-ship-fight-near-sun
eventBlueprint.title: Auto-ship fight near sun
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive at the beacon to find yourself dangerously close to a star. An automated Rebel ship, impervious to the heat, moves in to engage.

eventBlueprint.name: auto-ship-near-radar-station
eventBlueprint.title: Auto-ship near radar station
eventBlueprint.text: A Rebel automated ship sits dormant near a Rebel forward radar station.

choice.name: c:auto-ship-near-radar-station:1
choice.text: Keep your distance and wait for the FTL to charge

eventBlueprint.name: auto-ship-near-sensor-station
eventBlueprint.title: Auto-ship near sensor station
eventBlueprint.alias: Rebel Automated Ship Near Sensor Station
eventBlueprint.text: You detect a Rebel automated ship nearby. It does not engage and seems to be patrolling around a long-range sensor station.

choice.name: c:auto-ship-near-sensor-station:0
choice.text: Attack the automated ship to get to the sensor station

eventBlueprint.name: auto-ship-near-storage-station-in-nebula
eventBlueprint.title: Auto-ship near storage station in nebula
eventBlueprint.alias: Auto-ship near storage station in nebula
eventBlueprint.text: An advance <!-- [sic] -->rebel automated ship remains stationed near a small Rebel space-station. However, without functioning sensors it is impossible to tell what is inside.

choice.name: c:auto-ship-near-storage-station-in-nebula:0
choice.text: Attack the automated ship to get to the station

choice.name: c:auto-ship-warning:0
choice.text: Fight an Auto-ship that is running away

eventBlueprint.name: boarders-humans-in-plasma-storm
eventBlueprint.title: Boarders: Humans in plasma storm
eventBlueprint.text: You find two heavily damaged ships floating nearby, the remains of a battle. You begin to harvest some usable debris when you hear the sounds of someone beaming aboard followed by the shouts of a boarding party.

choice.name: c:boarders-humans-in-plasma-storm:0
choice.text: You receive medium scrap with resources

eventBlueprint.name: crystal-fight-with-surrender-offer-human-crew
eventBlueprint.title: Crystal fight with surrender offer (Human crew)
eventBlueprint.alias: Crystal fight with surrender offer (Human crew)
eventBlueprint.text: Crystal shards fly past your ship as soon as you jump. You scan to find the assailant and discover a Crystalline ship carrying a number of humans in it's cargo bay. It must be hunting the intruding ships!

eventBlueprint.name: crystal-fight-with-surrender-offer-hull-repairs
eventBlueprint.title: Crystal fight with surrender offer (hull repairs)
eventBlueprint.alias: Crystal fight with surrender offer (hull repairs)
eventBlueprint.text: A large convoy of lumbering civilian ships appears to be passing through this region. You show no hostile intentions, but they are taking no chances, immediately sending their escort to attack!

eventBlueprint.name: crystal-ship-attacking-federation-loyalists
eventBlueprint.title: Crystal ship attacking Federation loyalists
eventBlueprint.text: There appears to be a fight going on nearby. A Crystalline border guard is chasing a small Federation ship!

eventBlueprint.name: crystalline-ship-messaging-about-rebels
eventBlueprint.title: Crystalline ship messaging about Rebels
eventBlueprint.text: The moment you arrive you notice a Crystalline ship in the vicinity keeping its distance. They message you, "The 'Rebels' that are trying to hunt YOU down are creating havoc everywhere they go." "To minimize their impact on our people, we would like you to give them your flight path out of our sector. We would like to remain civil and are willing to pay you in 'scrap' for the increased danger it poses.

choice.name: c:crystalline-ship-messaging-about-rebels:1
choice.text: Accept the scrap but give them false flight plans

choice.name: c:crystalline-ship-messaging-about-rebels:2
choice.text: Accept the scrap but give them falsified flight plans.

eventBlueprint.name: deactivated-auto-ship
eventBlueprint.title: Deactivated Auto-ship
eventBlueprint.text: You find a Rebel automated scout floating near this beacon. Despite its pristine condition, it appears to be de-activated.

choice.name: c:deactivated-auto-ship:0
choice.text: Don't risk activating it, and just strip the ship for any useful scrap

eventBlueprint.name: engi-distress-rebel-fight
eventBlueprint.title: Engi distress Rebel fight
eventBlueprint.text: The distress signal originates at a small Engi ship under attack by a rebel fighter - but when they see Federation markings they turn to attack!

eventBlueprint.name: engi-smashed-ships
eventBlueprint.title: Engi smashed ships
eventBlueprint.text: What appeared to be a single damaged ship is in fact two ships that have smashed into each other... there is a flurry of comm signals and damage, and it's hard to determine what occurred. The vessels appear to be... Engi? They look locked together by the impact and can't free themselves.

choice.name: c:engi-smashed-ships:0
choice.text: Attempt to help the ships by prying them apart

choice.name: c:engi-smashed-ships:2
choice.text: Have your Engi crewmember hail the vessel and assess the damage.
choice.effect: Random resources with some scrap.

eventBlueprint.name: federation-deserters
eventBlueprint.title: Federation deserters
eventBlueprint.text: For a moment you assume it's a glitch, but no... you've found a Federation military ship! They hail you and, after some probing, reveal that they deserted the Federation fleet before stumbling into this sector while seeking refuge.

choice.name: c:free-drone-schematic:0
choice.text: You receive a drone schematic with low scrap

choice.name: c:free-scrap-with-resources:0
choice.text: You receive medium scrap with resources

eventBlueprint.name: free-scrap-with-resources-lanius
eventBlueprint.title: Free scrap with resources (Lanius)
eventBlueprint.text: You stumble across a badly damaged Lanius craft. It jumps away as soon as it sees you. Looking around the area, you discover a number of destroyed Rebel automated ships. It must have been quite the fight. You scrap what remains.

choice.name: c:free-scrap-with-resources-lanius:0
choice.text: You receive high scrap with resources

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-fight-with-friendly-asb-support
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius fight with friendly ASB support
eventBlueprint.alias: Anti-Ship Battery Firing on Lanius Ships
Lanius fight with friendly ASB support
eventBlueprint.text: After the fight

choice.name: c:lanius-fight-with-friendly-asb-support:0
choice.text: Fight a Lanius ship with an Anti-Ship Battery on your side

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-ship-absorbing-automated-scout
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius ship absorbing automated scout
eventBlueprint.text: You come across a Lanius ship in the process of absorbing a Rebel automated scout. If you scare off the Lanius you could probably make use of it.

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-ship-attacking-mantis
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius ship attacking Mantis
eventBlueprint.text: The Mantis ship in this system looks like its distress beacon is malfunctioning... likely due to the Lanius ship mining their hull and sub-systems! It doesn't look like the Mantis ship will last much longer.

choice.name: c:lanius-ship-attacking-mantis:1
choice.text: Leave the Mantis to their fate

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-ship-attacking-rock
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius ship attacking Rock
eventBlueprint.text: A distress beacon pulses weakly from a Rockman ship in this system... their hull (and their crew) are being mined by the Lanius, lasers and weapons tearing through the ship!

choice.name: c:lanius-ship-attacking-rock:1
choice.text: Leave the Rockmen to their fate

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-ship-attacking-civilian-distress
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius ship attacking civilian distress
eventBlueprint.text: You immediately do a short-range scan after arriving at the beacon. It appears to be coming from a small civilian vessel under fire from a Lanius ship. Not all Lanius are content with simply scavenging the wrecks of previous battles.

choice.name: c:lanius-ship-attacking-civilian-distress:2
choice.text: Have your crew admonish their captain.
choice.effect: A Lanius crewmember starts a fight or powers the ship down.

eventBlueprint.title: Lanius ship in rich debris field
eventBlueprint.alias: Lanius ship in rich debris field

choice.name: c:lanius-ship-in-rich-debris-field:3

choice.name: c:lanius-ship-in-rich-debris-field:4

choice.name: c:lanius-ship-salvager:2
choice.effect: A Lanius crewmember may receive medium scrap only, a scoff, or nothing.

choice.name: c:lanius-trader:1

choice.name: c:lanius-trader:2

eventBlueprint.name: legendary-thief-kazaaakplethkilik
eventBlueprint.title: Legendary thief KazaaakplethKilik
eventBlueprint.text: You cross paths with a Mantis ship that looks to have had dozens of layers of armor-plating added over what must have been a hundred year career. Its captain is legendary thief KazaaakplethKilik. Your crew look frightened.

eventBlueprint.name: mantis-outcasts
eventBlueprint.title: Mantis outcasts
eventBlueprint.text: The Mantis outcasts sometimes make the mistake of taking the Zoltan for easy game. A scout moves in to attack while a boarding party beams aboard from a nearby transport!

choice.name: c:mantis-outcasts:0
choice.text: 2-3 mantis boarders beam aboard your ship and you fight a Mantis Ship (default rewards)

eventBlueprint.name: mantis-ship-attacking-crystal
eventBlueprint.title: Mantis ship attacking Crystal
eventBlueprint.text: You discover a number of civilian ships fleeing the area. Shots are fired and you find the assailant; a Mantis ship is attacking one of the smaller ships!

eventBlueprint.name: mantis-war-camp
eventBlueprint.title: Mantis war camp
eventBlueprint.text: You receive a request, "All of our military ships have been destroyed or damaged during the rebellion. However, there have been reports of a Mantis war camp only a few jumps from us. Can you help?"

choice.name: c:mantis-war-camp:0
choice.text: Pledge to do what you can

eventBlueprint.name: no-fuel-auto-ship-warning
eventBlueprint.title: No fuel: Auto-ship warning
eventBlueprint.text: A ship responding to your distress moves in. Unfortunately it turns out to be an automated Rebel scout. It immediately reverses thrust after scanning your ship.

choice.name: c:no-fuel-auto-ship-warning:0
choice.text: Fight an Auto-ship that is running away

choice.name: c:no-fuel-engi-ship-repair:2
choice.text: Offer to help repair their hull.

choice.name: c:no-fuel-mantis-fight:0
choice.text: Fight a Mantis ship that is running away

choice.name: c:no-fuel-rebel-fight:0
choice.text: Fight a Rebel ship that is running away

eventBlueprint.name: no-fuel-slug-fuel-depot
eventBlueprint.title: No fuel: Slug fuel depot
eventBlueprint.text: A mobile Slugman fuel depot enters scanning range. "My prices are fair, but I ask one thing - do not insult me with negotiation!" You check out his price list.

eventBlueprint.name: no-fuel-explore-the-system
eventBlueprint.title: No fuel: explore the system
eventBlueprint.text: Although your lack of fuel cells prevents your ship from jumping, you can still use your impulse engines. Will you spend some time exploring the nearby system?

choice.name: c:pirate-briber:1
choice.text: Try to be a hero. Attack the pirate

eventBlueprint.name: pirate-ship-attacking-civilian-distress
eventBlueprint.title: Pirate ship attacking civilian distress
eventBlueprint.text: The distress beacon is coming from a civilian ship. It appears it is being chased by a pirate.

eventBlueprint.name: pirate-ship-selling-drones
eventBlueprint.title: Pirate ship selling drones
eventBlueprint.text: A ship with conspicuous pirate markings is orbiting a nearby moon, broadcasting a simple message claiming to have equipment available for sale.

choice.name: c:pirate-ship-selling-drones:1
choice.text: Attack him before he can attack!

eventBlueprint.name: pirate-ship-selling-weapon
eventBlueprint.title: Pirate ship selling weapon
eventBlueprint.text: A black market weapons trader spins you a tale of the dangers of the nebula before pushing his wares.

choice.name: c:pirate-ship-selling-weapon:2
choice.text: Convince him to make it a better deal.
choice.effect: A declined deal, or a Pirate ship.

choice.name: c:rebel-checkpoint:0
choice.text: Fend for yourself, attack, and escape

choice.name: c:rebel-checkpoint:1
choice.text: Fly behind a moon and stay hidden

eventBlueprint.name: rebel-fight-among-federation-and-rebel-fleets
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel fight among Federation and Rebel fleets
eventBlueprint.alias: Rebel fight among Federation and Rebel fleets

eventBlueprint.name: rebel-fight-in-plasma-storm
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel fight in plasma storm
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive in the middle of a plasma storm. Despite the harsh conditions, a Rebel scout seems to be waiting for you.

eventBlueprint.name: rebel-ship-attacking-crystal-ship
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel ship attacking Crystal ship
eventBlueprint.text: Crystal shards fly past the screen as soon as you arrive. Checking the scanners, it looks like a crystalline ship is engaged with a Rebel!

eventBlueprint.name: rebel-ship-attacking-federation-loyalists
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel ship attacking Federation loyalists
eventBlueprint.alias: Federation Ship in Need of Aid

eventBlueprint.name: rebel-ship-attacking-civilians-in-last-stand
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel ship attacking civilians in Last Stand
eventBlueprint.alias: Rebel Attacking Civilians in Last Stand
Rebel ship attacking civilians in Last Stand

choice.name: c:rebel-ship-attacking-civilians-in-last-stand:0
choice.text: Prepare to fight the Rebel ship!

choice.name: c:rebel-ship-attacking-civilians-in-last-stand:1
choice.text: There's no time, get ready to jump

eventBlueprint.name: rebel-ship-attacking-refueling-outpost
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel ship attacking refueling outpost
eventBlueprint.text: You detect a Rebel scout on an attack approach to a small refueling outpost. Their weapons are charged, but they're not firing yet.

choice.name: c:rebel-ship-supplying-civilians:2
choice.text: Wait and steal the supplies from the civilians

eventBlueprint.name: rebel-shipyard
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel shipyard
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive at the beacon to find yourself in a huge Rebel shipyard, scaffolding and construction drones filling the sector! The entire system looks devoted to ship construction, the nearby planets and moons ruthlessly mined to harvest resources for a ship of immense size...

eventBlueprint.name: rebel-transport-ship
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel transport ship
eventBlueprint.text: You spot a small rebel ship nearby. It seems to have been re-fitted for transport rather than combat. It does not seem to want to engage you and your ship.

choice.name: c:rebel-transport-ship:0
choice.text: Demand the surrender of their goods

eventBlueprint.name: refueling-platform
eventBlueprint.title: Refueling platform
eventBlueprint.text: A small platform orbits near this beacon - it looks like a fueling station of some sort, and it is cheerily broadcasting reasonable prices in a spectrum of frequencies and languages.

eventBlueprint.name: refueling-station
eventBlueprint.title: Refueling station
eventBlueprint.text: A ship re-fueling station is stationed at this beacon. We can purchase fuel here.

choice.name: c:rock-atheists:0
choice.text: Tell them their god sent them here to join your crew

eventBlueprint.name: rock-ship-in-plasma-storm
eventBlueprint.title: Rock ship in plasma storm
eventBlueprint.text: A rock armoured transport nearby looks to have lost its bearings, but when you hail they grow suspicious: "Whatever life-form you are, we find you repugnant. We seek no aid. Leave. Now."

eventBlueprint.name: sell-drone-parts-for-scrap
eventBlueprint.title: Sell drone parts for scrap
eventBlueprint.text: You see a civilian space station with heavy damage. You receive a message, "We've been hit hard by the war. We need more drone parts to speed up our repairs. We'll buy some from you if you have extra."

eventBlueprint.name: sell-missiles-for-scrap
eventBlueprint.title: Sell missiles for scrap
eventBlueprint.text: There is a black market hub here. You receive a message, "These are dangerous times. If you have extra military-grade explosives, we'll gladly pay you for them."

eventBlueprint.name: slaver-friendly
eventBlueprint.title: Slaver (friendly)
eventBlueprint.text: You recognize the ship as a well known slave trader. He hails you and offers you "laborers" for cheap.

choice.name: c:slaver-friendly:1
choice.text: Ignore the slaver and continue on your way

eventBlueprint.name: slaver-hostile
eventBlueprint.title: Slaver (hostile)
eventBlueprint.text: An especially well-armed pirate ship approaches you. "Hand over one of your crew and the rest can go unharmed."

choice.name: c:slaver-hostile:2
choice.text: Draw straws and send a crew-member over to the slavers.

choice.name: c:slaver-hostile:0
choice.text: We will never surrender one of our crew to slavers!

choice.name: c:slaver-hostile:1
choice.text: Attempt to out-run the slaver ship.

eventBlueprint.name: slug-drink
eventBlueprint.title: Slug drink
eventBlueprint.text: A Slug captain hails and invites himself aboard your ship to present a flask of something slimy. "Now, most gracioussss captain, you must join me please in a drink to our alliance!"

eventBlueprint.name: slug-hacker-choice
eventBlueprint.title: Slug hacker (choice)
eventBlueprint.text: You are immediately hailed by a dangerous looking ship. "I'm feeling generouss today. I shall allow you to choose your own death. Which do you like leasst: shields, oxygen, or weaponsss?"

choice.name: c:slug-hacker-choice:3
choice.text: Offer 35 scrap to leave you alone

eventBlueprint.name: slug-hacker-doors
eventBlueprint.title: Slug hacker (doors)
eventBlueprint.text: There are few more vicious beasts in the galaxy than a Slug with his back to the wall. The faltering ship armed with fire-weapons uses a remote hacking tool to try and disable your door system - they're going to burn you out!

eventBlueprint.name: slug-hacker-medical
eventBlueprint.title: Slug hacker (medical)
eventBlueprint.text: A Slug ship hails you: "We've detected some worrying radiation coming from your medical unit, perhaps you should take a look?" As he signs off, your medical bay shuts off and their crew teleports aboard from a nearby station. They don't look like engineers.

choice.name: c:slug-hacker-medical:2
choice.text: Try to squeeze some extra power to the system.

eventBlueprint.name: slug-hacker-oxygen
eventBlueprint.title: Slug hacker (oxygen)
eventBlueprint.text: The slugs here use a tactic you hoped you'd never see: They sabotage your oxygen production system and then charge fire-weapons - you're going to suffocate!

choice.name: c:slug-hacker-oxygen:1
choice.text: Try to squeeze some extra power to the system.

eventBlueprint.name: space-station-under-construction
eventBlueprint.title: Space station under construction
eventBlueprint.text: You come across a space station under construction. You receive a message from their command tower, "Greetings. We recently lost contact with a cargo ship that was set to deliver more construction materials. Could you help us figure out what happened to them?"

eventBlueprint.name: the-engi-virus
eventBlueprint.title: The Engi virus
eventBlueprint.text: The Engi are awaiting you at the beacon, with their weapons on-line! They explain a computer virus that is wanted for hostile acts against the Engi (multiple counts of binary scrambling, nano-dissolution, and variable interference) is aboard your vessel. They insist they must destroy your ship to prevent the virus from escaping!

choice.name: c:the-engi-virus:0
choice.text: Hold on! Let us try to purge the system code!

choice.name: c:the-mercenary:0
choice.text: Hire the mercenary to delay the Rebels

choice.name: c:the-mercenary:2
choice.text: You have no need of his services

eventBlueprint.name: zoltan-retake-the-ship
eventBlueprint.title: Zoltan retake the ship
eventBlueprint.text: You pick up a Zoltan life raft floating in space. Its inhabitant asks you to retake his ship from the pirates who recently commandeered it. "I'm certain it is clear," he concludes, "that you must not destroy my vessel in the process."

eventBlueprint.name: zoltan-wise-man
eventBlueprint.title: Zoltan wise man
eventBlueprint.text: You come to a quiet part of Zoltan space and encounter an ancient Zoltan wise man who has managed to harness the power of a spatial rift, but seems to have been driven completely mad by the power. "Choose your doom," he demands. This is all part of a day's work.

eventBlueprint.name: boarders-humans-abandoned
eventBlueprint.title: Boarders: Humans (Abandoned)
eventBlueprint.text: An image of some weak and hungry humans comes onto your screen. "Those metal bastards think they can just absorb half of our engines and leave us here to die? I hope you understand the need to take your ship by force."

choice.name: c:boarders-humans-abandoned:0
choice.text: 3-4 human boarders beam aboard your ship

eventBlueprint.name: auto-ship-fight-in-plasma-storm
eventBlueprint.title: Auto-ship fight in plasma storm
eventBlueprint.text: You jump into a sector of the nebula beset by a plasma storm. An automated Rebel scout stationed at the beacon moves in to attack.

eventBlueprint.name: auto-ship-near-storage-station
eventBlueprint.title: Auto-ship near storage station
eventBlueprint.text: An advanced Rebel automated ship remains stationed near a small Rebel space-station. Sensors indicate it's a storage vessel for military goods.

choice.name: c:auto-ship-near-storage-station:0
choice.text: Attack the automated ship to get to the storage cache

eventBlueprint.name: auto-ship-warning-in-nebula
eventBlueprint.title: Auto-ship warning in nebula
eventBlueprint.text: It appears that an automated Rebel scout was positioned within the nebula to warn of your passing.

choice.name: c:auto-ship-warning-in-nebula:0
choice.text: Fight an Auto-ship that is running away

choice.name: c:free-weapon:0
choice.text: You receive a weapon with low scrap

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-fight-distress
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius fight distress
eventBlueprint.text: You are too late - whatever once was emitting the distress signal from this system drew a Lanius ship as well as your own. Having consumed the original target, the Lanius turn their attention to your vessel.

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-fight-in-asteroid-field
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius fight in asteroid field
eventBlueprint.text: This beacon appears to have been set up within an asteroid field to access a mining settlement. However, half of the settlement has been disassembled by a number of Lanius scavengers. Their military escort moves in to scare you off.

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-fight-near-pulsar
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius fight near pulsar
eventBlueprint.text: There appears to be some sort of research station near a pulsar, although it's hard to tell since a portion of it has been melted. The Lanius ship that has been working at it moves in to intercept you, totally oblivious to the threat of EM pulses.

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-lone-ship
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius lone ship
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive at the beacon to discover a civilian ship fleeing from a lone Lanius craft. The civilian messages you, "Help! The metal monsters are coming to melt down our ship!" Strangely, no active weapon signatures are detected.

choice.name: c:lanius-lone-ship:2
choice.text: Try to contact the Lanius ship.
choice.effect: Continuing may open a store, start a Lanius fight, or do nothing.

choice.name: c:lanius-lone-ship:3
choice.effect: A Lanius crewmember opens a store.

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-powered-down-ship
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius powered-down ship
eventBlueprint.text: You have picked up a Lanius vessel drifting in this sector. There is no damage to the hull, and it appears to be powered down.

choice.name: c:lanius-powered-down-ship:1
choice.effect: They wake and fight, or stay silent.

choice.name: c:lanius-powered-down-ship:2
