eventBlueprint.name: lanius-ship-attacking-slug
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius ship attacking Slug
eventBlueprint.text: The distress signal from this system is coming from a Slug vessel under attack by the Lanius! The Slugs beg for assistance as the Lanius tear into their hull plating.

choice.name: c:lanius-ship-attacking-slug:1
choice.text: Leave the Slugs to their fate

eventBlueprint.name: boarders-humans-in-nebula
eventBlueprint.title: Boarders: Humans in nebula
eventBlueprint.text: You see a small station nearby and feel the shudder of shots ringing through the ship. You can't be sure without sensors, but it seems there may be intruders on the ship!

choice.name: c:boarders-humans-in-nebula:0
choice.text: 2-4 human boarders beam aboard your ship.

eventBlueprint.name: boarders-rebels-in-nebula
eventBlueprint.title: Boarders: rebels in nebula
eventBlueprint.text: There appear to be a number of small stations nearby. Before you have time to scan them, warnings go off. A Rebel teleporter was used in one of the stations. You've been boarded!

choice.name: c:boarders-rebels-in-nebula:0
choice.text: 3-4 human boarders beam aboard your ship.

eventBlueprint.name: pirate-engine-hacker
eventBlueprint.title: Pirate engine hacker
eventBlueprint.text: Once you arrive, your screen lights up with warnings. A nearby pirate seems to have advanced hacking tools and they have tried to shut down our engines. Your crew manages to keep them operational and you move in to attack.

eventBlueprint.name: pirate-fight-in-asteroid-field
eventBlueprint.title: Pirate fight in asteroid field
eventBlueprint.text: A pirate ship was lying in wait inside this asteroid field. It immediately moves in to attack.

eventBlueprint.name: pirate-fight-near-sun
eventBlueprint.title: Pirate fight near sun
eventBlueprint.text: This beacon has been placed too close to a super-giant class M star! The ship will gradually overheat until you get out of here... or die. A pirate, apparently oblivious to the danger of the sun, moves in to engage.

eventBlueprint.name: pirate-toll
eventBlueprint.title: Pirate toll
eventBlueprint.text: Upon completing your jump, you receive a message from a nearby ship. "Greetings and welcome to our beacon! For a small fee, we'll let you continue on your way."

eventBlueprint.name: rebel-fight-choice-in-nebula
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel fight choice in nebula
eventBlueprint.text: Your ship emerges quite far away from the beacon. You see a rebel ship waiting nearby, undoubtedly stationed to look for you.

eventBlueprint.name: rebel-ship-warning
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel ship warning
eventBlueprint.text: You stumble across a forward scout of the Rebel fleet.

choice.name: c:rebel-ship-warning:0
choice.text: Fight a Rebel ship that is running away

eventBlueprint.name: refueling-platform-garbled-broadcast
eventBlueprint.title: Refueling platform garbled broadcast
eventBlueprint.text: You detect a refueling platform near the beacon, although its broadcast signal is garbled, and you can't make out the message.

choice.name: c:refueling-platform-garbled-broadcast:0
choice.text: Hail the platform and attempt to communicate

eventBlueprint.name: remote-settlement
eventBlueprint.title: Remote settlement
eventBlueprint.text: Scans show a remote settlement being blockaded by a pirate ship. The ship hastily messages you, "Stay out of this, or you'll be next!...Concentrate fire on..."

choice.name: c:remote-settlement:2
choice.text: Show the pirate how to intimidate settlers: burn their crops!

choice.name: c:remote-settlement:3
choice.text: Show the pirate how to intimidate settlers: start fires in their crude dwellings.

eventBlueprint.name: repair-station
eventBlueprint.title: Repair station
eventBlueprint.text: You see a small station fitted with hundreds of Repair drones. You receive an automated message, "We don't know who you are and we don't care, but this is the right place for some ship repair!"

choice.name: c:repair-station:0
choice.effect: "Thank you for your business, no refunds!"

choice.name: c:repair-station:1
choice.effect: "Thank you for your business, no refunds!"

choice.name: c:repair-station:2
choice.effect: "Thank you for your business, no refunds!"

eventBlueprint.name: crystal-fight-choice
eventBlueprint.title: Crystal fight choice
eventBlueprint.text: You're greeted by an unwelcome sight - a Rebel advance ship is laying down fire on a Crystalline vessel in the distance.

eventBlueprint.name: pirate-ship-attacking-crystal
eventBlueprint.title: Pirate ship attacking Crystal
eventBlueprint.text: A pirate ship jumps in right after you arrive at the beacon. It must have followed once the Long-Range Beacon was reactivated. It almost charges a small Crystalline transport ship, weapons armed.

eventBlueprint.name: rebel-fight-crystal
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel fight (Crystal)
eventBlueprint.text: As soon as you arrive, a Rebel ship jumps in after you; they must be really hot on your tail.

eventBlueprint.name: boarders-crystal
eventBlueprint.title: Boarders: Crystal
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive near a small settlement and a lone guard ship moves to intercept you. You try to contact them but they are refusing all hails. Suddenly you hear lasers ricocheting from within the ship. You've been boarded!

choice.name: c:boarders-crystal:0
choice.text: 2-3 crystal boarders beam aboard your ship.

eventBlueprint.name: pirate-fight-engi
eventBlueprint.title: Pirate fight (Engi)
eventBlueprint.text: There must have been rich pickings for pirates around here up until war broke out. The pirate you encounter here looks worn down, but hungry. You'll have to fight!

eventBlueprint.name: rebel-fight-engi
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel fight (Engi)
eventBlueprint.text: The rebel fighter here would seem to suggest elements of the rebel fleet are already making incursions on Engi space. You move to engage.

eventBlueprint.name: confused-mantis
eventBlueprint.title: Confused Mantis
eventBlueprint.text: As soon as you jump into the system, you receive a hail from a nearby civilian Engi vessel. Their Captain appears on your screen: "Strange bug. Can you assist in debugging?"

choice.name: c:confused-mantis:1
choice.text: Explain that you can't do any programming and leave.

eventBlueprint.name: mantis-fugitive
eventBlueprint.title: Mantis fugitive
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive just in time to see an unusually well-armed Engi ship destroying a small pirate craft. A teleporter signal is detected...intruder on deck!

choice.name: c:mantis-fugitive:0
choice.text: Side with the fugitive and fight the Engi ship.

choice.name: c:mantis-fugitive:1
choice.text: Agree to offer up the Mantis in exchange for a bounty.
choice.effect: High scrap, hull and fire, or a boarder and an Engi ship.

eventBlueprint.name: mantis-fight-near-sun
eventBlueprint.title: Mantis fight near sun
eventBlueprint.text: Who knows why the Mantis would venture so close to a sun. Perhaps it makes for more of a challenge?

eventBlueprint.name: mantis-ship-collectors
eventBlueprint.title: Mantis ship-collectors
eventBlueprint.text: You are immediately hailed by an impressive-looking Mantis ship, "Your ship would make a mighty fine prize. Prepare for battle!"

eventBlueprint.name: boarders-humans-near-sun
eventBlueprint.title: Boarders: Humans near sun
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive to find yourself extremely close to a star. You receive a message from a pirate ship, "I'm glad you arrived; our ship is damaged and we were getting desperate... I hope you don't mind if we take yours." Hostiles detected on board our ship!

choice.name: c:boarders-humans-near-sun:0
choice.text: 2-4 human boarders beam aboard your ship.

eventBlueprint.name: boarders-mantis
eventBlueprint.title: Boarders: Mantis
eventBlueprint.text: A derelict and still smoking Mantis vessel floats by. The battle must have been recent; its surviving crew beam aboard. Prepare for a fight!

choice.name: c:boarders-mantis:0
choice.text: 2-4 mantis boarders beam aboard your ship.

eventBlueprint.name: escape-pod
eventBlueprint.title: Escape pod
eventBlueprint.text: You detect and retrieve an escape pod floating nearby. You consider returning it to space when you learn it's Mantis.

choice.name: c:escape-pod:1
choice.effect: A Mantis boarder and a lost crewmember, or nothing.

eventBlueprint.name: refugee-pirate
eventBlueprint.title: Refugee (Pirate)
eventBlueprint.text: Your sensors have picked up a refugee ship drifting through the system, no doubt one of many fleeing the Rebel advance. It doesn't appear to have detected you... or else it is trying to avoid notice.

choice.name: c:refugee-pirate:0
choice.effect: A trade, or a pirate ship using them as bait.

eventBlueprint.name: refugee-distress-pirate
eventBlueprint.title: Refugee distress (Pirate)
eventBlueprint.text: You have encountered a refugee ship drifting in space. It looks as if it was fleeing the Rebel advance and ran out of fuel. Its distress beacon is active, but you're not sure anyone is on board.

choice.name: c:refugee-distress-pirate:0
choice.effect: A trade, or a pirate ship using them as bait.

eventBlueprint.name: research-station-with-no-response
eventBlueprint.title: Research station with no response
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive to find a small research station putting out a distress signal. There is no response to your hails.

choice.name: c:research-station-with-no-response:0
choice.text: Dock with the station and investigate.
choice.effect: The station investigation.

choice.name: c:research-station-with-no-response:2
choice.text: Send your battle drone in to help.
choice.effect: Nothing, or medium scrap with resources.

choice.name: c:research-station-with-no-response:3
choice.effect: Medium scrap with resources, or nothing.

eventBlueprint.name: mantis-ship-with-rock-body-parts
eventBlueprint.title: Mantis ship with Rock body parts
eventBlueprint.alias: Mantis ship with Rock body parts
eventBlueprint.text: A Mantis ship here is adorned with Rock body parts! It would be a gorier display if they had internal organs, but the message is clear enough: this is a hunter of a very specialized kind.

choice.name: c:mantis-ship-with-rock-body-parts:2
choice.text: Put your Rock crewmember on the comm.

eventBlueprint.name: rock-fight-with-boarders-in-asteroid-field
eventBlueprint.title: Rock fight with boarders in asteroid field
eventBlueprint.alias: Rock fight with boarders in asteroid field
Rock Fight With Boarders in Asteroid Field
Rock Fight with Boarders in Asteroid Field

eventBlueprint.name: rock-pirates-fight-in-asteroid-field
eventBlueprint.title: Rock pirates fight in asteroid field
eventBlueprint.alias: Rock pirates fight in asteroid field
Rock pirate fight in asteroid field

eventBlueprint.name: boarders-rockmen-near-sun
eventBlueprint.title: Boarders: Rockmen near sun
eventBlueprint.text: As soon as you arrive you hear the telltale sounds of a teleporter and shouts reverberating through the ship, "Prepare to burn, fleshy meat-sack aliens!"

choice.name: c:boarders-rockmen-near-sun:0
choice.text: 2-3 rock boarders beam aboard your ship.

eventBlueprint.name: disabled-rock-ship
eventBlueprint.title: Disabled Rock ship
eventBlueprint.text: You find a disabled rock transport floating near the beacon. You consider stripping it of useful parts but are uncertain why it's there in the first place.

choice.name: c:disabled-rock-ship:0
choice.effect: Random scrap, or that scrap and a Rock ship.

choice.name: c:disabled-rock-ship:1
choice.effect: Nothing, or a Rock ship.

choice.name: c:disabled-rock-ship:2
choice.text: Check for lifeforms and keep a lookout for ships while looting the wreck.
choice.effect: Random scrap.

eventBlueprint.name: rock-and-slug-standoff
eventBlueprint.title: Rock and Slug standoff
eventBlueprint.text: You find a Slug Cruiser and Rock ship at a standoff, both with weapons armed and ready to fight. You could intervene before this gets out of hand.

choice.name: c:rock-and-slug-standoff:0
choice.text: Hail them to see what's wrong.
choice.effect: Pay the debt, demand payment, or leave.

choice.name: c:rock-and-slug-standoff:1
choice.effect: Nothing happens.

eventBlueprint.name: mantis-ships-battle-for-rock-freighter
eventBlueprint.title: Mantis ships battle for Rock freighter
eventBlueprint.alias: Mantis ships battle for Rock freighter
Mantis Ships Battle for Rock Freighter
Mantis ships battle for Rock Freighter
eventBlueprint.text: A curious sight greets you at this beacon: a disabled Rock freighter drifts in space while two Mantis craft battle it out - presumably over who deserves the spoils.

choice.name: c:mantis-ships-battle-for-rock-freighter:0
choice.text: Wait, then attack the surviving Mantis.
choice.effect: A weakened Mantis ship, or a Mantis ship.

choice.name: c:mantis-ships-battle-for-rock-freighter:1
choice.effect: Nothing happens.

choice.name: c:mantis-ships-battle-for-rock-freighter:2
choice.effect: High scrap.

choice.name: c:mantis-ships-battle-for-rock-freighter:3
choice.effect: A Mantis ship.

eventBlueprint.name: rock-live-mine
eventBlueprint.title: Rock live mine
eventBlueprint.text: The burnt out hull of a Rock mine layer drifts by. Behind the wreck drifts a live mine; an automated drone that drills into ships' hulls before exploding. It locks onto your ship's signature and heads your way!

choice.name: c:rock-live-mine:0
choice.effect: The mine bites down.

choice.name: c:rock-live-mine:1
choice.effect: Nothing happens.

eventBlueprint.name: mantis-fight-slug
eventBlueprint.title: Mantis fight (Slug)
eventBlueprint.text: You intercept comm chatter from an incoming Mantis ship. "Look. This ship appears not to be owned by the squishy ones. Maybe they won't smell so bad when we cut them open." They move in on your position.

eventBlueprint.name: mantis-fight-choice-in-nebula
eventBlueprint.title: Mantis fight choice in nebula
eventBlueprint.text: Navigating the fog blind, you practically bump hulls with a Mantis ship. They hail you: "Pah! This transgression will be overlooked. Nebula, very dangerous. Next time, humans all die."

choice.name: c:mantis-fight-choice-in-nebula:0
choice.text: There won't be a next time. Open fire!

choice.name: c:mantis-fight-choice-in-nebula:1
choice.text: This place is dangerous enough. Move on.

eventBlueprint.name: mantis-fight-in-nebula-slug
eventBlueprint.title: Mantis fight in nebula (Slug)
eventBlueprint.text: The Mantis attack ship here looks to have been hunting Slugs on their home turf - a rare test of honor for the mightiest Mantis crews. Weapons up!

eventBlueprint.name: mantis-ship-attacking-slug-ship
eventBlueprint.title: Mantis ship attacking Slug ship
eventBlueprint.text: The distress call appears to be emanating from a Slug ship caught in open space by a Mantis raider. They contact you on emergency frequencies: "Please, we'll give you all we have if you sssave ussss!"

choice.name: c:mantis-ship-attacking-slug-ship:2
choice.text: Of all the species in the galaxy, these two deserve one another. You power up the jump drive.

eventBlueprint.name: pirate-fight-slug
eventBlueprint.title: Pirate fight (Slug)
eventBlueprint.text: There appears to be a pirate ship nearby.

eventBlueprint.name: pirate-fight-choice-in-nebula
eventBlueprint.title: Pirate fight choice in nebula
eventBlueprint.text: You're surprised to find a ship without Slug markings stranded all the way out here, and move in to provide assistance. When you see the pirate insignia on the hull you quickly reconsider.

choice.name: c:pirate-fight-choice-in-nebula:1
choice.text: Keep your distance and hope they haven't seen you yet.

eventBlueprint.name: rebel-fight-slug
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel fight (Slug)
eventBlueprint.text: As you arrive at the beacon, a hostile ship immediately registers on your scanners.

eventBlueprint.name: slug-home-nebula-surrender
eventBlueprint.title: Slug Home Nebula surrender
eventBlueprint.text: This is the Slug Cruiser ship unlocking event.

eventBlueprint.name: slug-fight
eventBlueprint.title: Slug fight
eventBlueprint.text: It's rare for the Slugs to stay exposed in open space for long periods - the ship here may be lost, or just passing through, but either way he moves in to attack!

eventBlueprint.name: slug-fight-in-nebula
eventBlueprint.title: Slug fight in nebula
eventBlueprint.text: Your sensors are no match for the Slug's telepathic abilities - a ship you never even saw opens fire from astern!

eventBlueprint.name: slug-fight-in-plasma-storm
eventBlueprint.title: Slug fight in plasma storm
eventBlueprint.text: The ion storm here threatens to deactivate your core systems, a fact made all the worse for the largely unaffected Slug ships circling like space-vultures.

eventBlueprint.name: rebel-fight-chance-in-nebula
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel fight chance in nebula
eventBlueprint.text: You spot a rebel ship in the nebula ahead and stay off their radar. Try to engage?

choice.name: c:rebel-fight-chance-in-nebula:1
choice.effect: A Rebel ship, doubled pursuit, or nothing.

choice.name: c:rebel-fight-chance-in-nebula:2
choice.text: Try to track them as you move to engage.

choice.name: c:rebel-fight-chance-in-nebula:3
choice.text: Try to track them as you move to engage.

choice.name: c:rebel-fight-chance-in-nebula:4
choice.text: Use their life signatures to follow.

eventBlueprint.name: slocknog
eventBlueprint.title: Slocknog
eventBlueprint.text: You detect life signs on a nearby moon - a lone Slug marooned on its surface. "Ah, a sssentient ssspecies, after all this time. I am Slocknog, a wandering hero ssseeking adventure. You may hire me for a ssmall sssum."

eventBlueprint.name: slug-ship-boarding-rock-ship
eventBlueprint.title: Slug ship boarding Rock ship
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive to find a Slug ship in the middle of boarding a disabled Rock freighter.

choice.name: c:slug-ship-boarding-rock-ship:1
choice.effect: Nothing, or a Rock ship.

eventBlueprint.name: refugee-slug
eventBlueprint.title: Refugee (Slug)
eventBlueprint.text: Your sensors have picked up a refugee ship drifting through the system, no doubt one of many fleeing the Rebel advance. It doesn't appear to have detected you... or else it is trying to avoid notice.

choice.name: c:refugee-slug:0
choice.effect: A trade, or a pirate ship using them as bait.

eventBlueprint.name: refugee-distress-slug
eventBlueprint.title: Refugee distress (Slug)
eventBlueprint.text: You have encountered a refugee ship drifting in space. It looks as if it was fleeing the Rebel advance and ran out of fuel. Its distress beacon is active, but you're not sure anyone is on board.

choice.name: c:refugee-distress-slug:0
choice.effect: A trade, or a pirate ship using them as bait.

eventBlueprint.name: engi-fight
eventBlueprint.title: Engi fight
eventBlueprint.text: You jump into a debris field that used to be a Zoltan cruiser. Unfortunately, its Engi escort takes you for the attacker and retaliates! They refuse all hails.

eventBlueprint.name: mantis-fight-zoltan
eventBlueprint.title: Mantis fight (Zoltan)
eventBlueprint.text: You pick up the last broadcast from a rupturing Zoltan freighter: "The Mantis, they're here, please-" You're interrupted by fire off the port bow!

eventBlueprint.name: pirate-ships-in-plasma-storm
eventBlueprint.title: Pirate ships in plasma storm
eventBlueprint.alias: Two pirate ships in plasma storm
eventBlueprint.text: You spy two pirate ships lurking in the nebula here. They remain unaware of your presence; you're able to get your scanners to at least identify their cargo: One is carrying the fuel supplies, the other the ammunition. They begin to drift away from each other in the storm.

eventBlueprint.name: rock-fight-in-nebula
eventBlueprint.title: Rock fight in nebula
eventBlueprint.text: This nebula turns out to be the hiding place of a terrified rock crew taking refuge from the Zoltan border police. They don't seem prepared to risk your leaving with their co-ordinates, and open fire!

eventBlueprint.name: zoltan-border-police
eventBlueprint.title: Zoltan border police
eventBlueprint.text: There are few more zealous in their customs checks than the Zoltan. A team of border police beam on board. There's just a little confusion over your weapons licences, but things escalate rapidly from heated discussion to gunfire!

eventBlueprint.name: zoltan-fight-in-asteroid-field
eventBlueprint.title: Zoltan fight in asteroid field
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive in an asteroid field and are greeted by a Zoltan guard, "By attempting to access these closed mining fields, you are in violation of the Natural Mineral Protection Act. Your weaponry will be confiscated for processing." You don't have time for this.

eventBlueprint.name: zoltan-free-augment
eventBlueprint.title: Zoltan free augment
eventBlueprint.text: A Zoltan academy sits docked just outside the beacon perimeter. They're happy to show you the fruits of their labor, and offer something to take home with you.

choice.name: c:zoltan-free-augment:0
choice.text: You receive an augmentation with low scrap

eventBlueprint.name: zoltan-quest-primitives
eventBlueprint.title: Zoltan quest primitives
eventBlueprint.text:
You arrive at the primitive planet that you heard about at the cantina and are surprised to see a Zoltan ship facing off against a Rebel assault craft.
You tap into their frequency and hear the Rebel captain yelling, "We are liberating this planet in the name of the new Galactic government! These aliens will not be left in ignorance where they cannot be of use!"

choice.name: c:zoltan-quest-primitives:0
choice.text: Interfere - make first contact with the primitive aliens

choice.name: c:zoltan-quest-primitives:1
choice.text: Protect the aliens' way of life - Attack the Rebel ship

eventBlueprint.name: zoltan-security-checkpoint
eventBlueprint.title: Zoltan security checkpoint
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive at a Zoltan security checkpoint set up in a perimeter around the beacon. "Traveling vessel, you will submit to crew profiling to identify fugitives of the empire."

choice.name: c:zoltan-security-checkpoint:0
choice.text: You don't have time for this nonsense. Attack!

eventBlueprint.name: zoltan-ship-follows-mantis-ship
eventBlueprint.title: Zoltan ship follows Mantis ship
eventBlueprint.text: Your jump interrupts a Zoltan security ship as it follows a Mantis pirate into an asteroid field. They message you, "Your presence here will continue to be tolerated - but please, do not interfere."

choice.name: c:zoltan-ship-follows-mantis-ship:0
choice.text: Interfere and save the Mantis ship

choice.name: c:zoltan-ship-follows-mantis-ship:1
choice.text: Interfere and help the Zoltan ship

eventBlueprint.name: boarders-humans-jammed-sensors
eventBlueprint.title: Boarders: Humans jammed sensors
eventBlueprint.text: You catch a glimpse of a strange signal coming from a space station before your sensors shut off unexpectedly. As you discover that your sensors are being jammed, you hear hostiles beam onto your ship.

eventBlueprint.name: zoltan-great-eye
eventBlueprint.title: Zoltan Great Eye
eventBlueprint.text: Inside this nebula you detect a rogue planet drifting through space, on its surface a huge monolith visible at this distance even to the naked eye. A Zoltan elder hails you from the planet. "Through luck or intent, you have discovered the Great Eye. Look into its depths and receive your just deserts."

choice.name: c:zoltan-great-eye:0
choice.effect: Lose a crewmember, a Zoltan ship, high scrap, or Healing Burst.

choice.name: c:no-fuel-rebel-fleet-delay:0
choice.text: Rebel Fleet pursuit is delayed for 1 jump
choice.effect: Another out of fuel event occurs.

eventBlueprint.name: no-fuel-friendly-refugee
eventBlueprint.title: No fuel: friendly refugee
eventBlueprint.text: While it doesn't have much fuel to spare, it recognizes you are part of the Federation and offers to split its remaining fuel with you.

eventBlueprint.name: dense-asteroid-field-distress
eventBlueprint.title: Dense asteroid field distress
eventBlueprint.text: A ship without life forms within a nearby dense asteroid field is giving off the distress call. Shall we investigate? It could be dangerous.

choice.name: c:dense-asteroid-field-distress:0
choice.effect: Hull and engines, random scrap, or the remains.

choice.name: c:dense-asteroid-field-distress:2
choice.text: Make a thorough search for the ship without fear of stray asteroids.
choice.effect: The remains.

choice.name: c:rebel-defector:1
choice.text: Reject his offer. You can never trust these Rebels.

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-ship-absorbing-jump-beacon
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius ship absorbing jump beacon
eventBlueprint.text: You detect a damaged vessel docked with the jump beacon. It appears the Lanius are absorbing metal from the beacon, risking destroying it and becoming stranded.

choice.name: c:lanius-ship-absorbing-jump-beacon:0
choice.effect: A Lanius ship, or the translator.

choice.name: c:lanius-ship-absorbing-jump-beacon:1
choice.effect: Nothing, or a Lanius ship.

choice.name: c:lanius-ship-absorbing-jump-beacon:2
choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Ask if they require assistance.
choice.effect: Nothing happens.

choice.name: c:lanius-ship-absorbing-jump-beacon:3
choice.text: (Hull Repair Drone) Send a drone to help.
choice.effect: A Lanius crewmember.

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-ship-absorbing-rebel-base
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius ship absorbing rebel base
eventBlueprint.text: You notice a number of Lanius ships absorbing a forward Rebel base and its automated scouts. They don't seem to be aggressive. Perhaps their desire for metal could prove to be useful?

choice.name: c:lanius-ship-absorbing-rebel-base:0
choice.text: Try to use them to delay the Rebels.
choice.effect: Medium scrap and a fleet delay, a Lanius ship, or nothing.

choice.name: c:lanius-ship-absorbing-rebel-base:1
choice.effect: Nothing happens.

choice.name: c:lanius-ship-absorbing-rebel-base:2
choice.text: Try to use them to delay the Rebels.
choice.effect: Medium scrap and a fleet delay.

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-craftsmen
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius craftsmen
eventBlueprint.text: A merchant ship is docked with a Lanius transport. You message them to see if they need any help. It turns out they have been studying the Lanius's ability to reshape metal.

choice.name: c:lanius-craftsmen:0
choice.effect: Nothing happens.

choice.name: c:lanius-craftsmen:1
choice.effect: Nothing happens.

eventBlueprint.name: slug-moons-question
eventBlueprint.title: Slug moons question
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive near the distress beacon's signal.

choice.name: c:slug-moons-question:0
choice.effect: The question follows.

choice.name: c:crystal-scrap-collector:0
choice.effect: Branched crew and weapon rewards are not granted.

eventBlueprint.name: boarders-humans-pirate
eventBlueprint.title: Boarders: Humans (Pirate)
eventBlueprint.text: What appears to be a civilian ship sends a friendly hail. As you approach the vessel, you detect a teleporter signal but it's too late... intruders have beamed aboard!

choice.name: c:boarders-humans-pirate:0
choice.text: 3-5 human boarders beam aboard your ship.

eventBlueprint.name: zoltan-odd-moon
eventBlueprint.title: Zoltan odd moon
eventBlueprint.text: Something strikes you as odd about a moon in the distance.

choice.name: c:zoltan-odd-moon:0
choice.effect: The moon has more than one result.

eventBlueprint.name: refugee-zoltan
eventBlueprint.title: Refugee (Zoltan)
eventBlueprint.text: Your sensors have picked up a refugee ship drifting through the system, no doubt one of many fleeing the Rebel advance. It doesn't appear to have detected you... or else it is trying to avoid notice.

choice.name: c:refugee-zoltan:0
choice.effect: A trade, or a Zoltan ship.

eventBlueprint.name: refugee-distress-zoltan
eventBlueprint.title: Refugee distress (Zoltan)
eventBlueprint.text: You have encountered a refugee ship drifting in space. It looks as if it was fleeing the Rebel advance and ran out of fuel. Its distress beacon is active, but you're not sure anyone is on board.

choice.name: c:refugee-distress-zoltan:0
choice.effect: A trade, or a Zoltan ship.

eventBlueprint.name: engi-surrender
eventBlueprint.title: Engi surrender
eventBlueprint.text: An Engi ship in the vicinity, seeing you jump in armed to the teeth, immediately broadcasts its surrender. "Subject goal: wealth. Engi motivation: survival. Transfer of goods acceptable?"

choice.name: c:engi-surrender:0
choice.effect: The Engi answer.

choice.name: c:engi-surrender:1
choice.effect: The Engi transfer the goods.

eventBlueprint.name: destroyed-cargo-ship
eventBlueprint.title: Destroyed cargo ship
eventBlueprint.text: Not too far from the beacon, you detect a destroyed cargo ship with its cargo scattered nearby, intact.

choice.name: c:destroyed-cargo-ship:1
choice.text: Leave it alone, this looks suspicious.

choice.name: c:destroyed-cargo-ship:2
choice.text: Run an advanced scan on the boxes.
choice.effect: Scan the boxes.

choice.name: c:destroyed-cargo-ship:3
choice.text: Run an advanced scan on the boxes.
choice.effect: Scan the boxes.

eventBlueprint.name: settlement-mercenary-work
eventBlueprint.title: Settlement mercenary work
eventBlueprint.text: You are immediately contacted by a settlement, "Hello, travelers. Your ship seems to be outfitted for combat...care to take up a bit of mercenary work?"

eventBlueprint.name: the-black-raven
eventBlueprint.title: The Black Raven
eventBlueprint.text: As you jump in, you immediately see an impressive Slug pirate ship with "The Black Raven" painted on one side. They hail you, "Greetingsss. I am the dreaded pirate, Captain Nights. You mussst be full of fear, no? You have heard of me... no?"

eventBlueprint.name: zoltan-ship-asks-to-dock
eventBlueprint.title: Zoltan ship asks to dock
eventBlueprint.text: What appears to be a Zoltan science ship requests permission to dock.

eventBlueprint.name: slug-comm-tapping
eventBlueprint.title: Slug comm tapping
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive to the sight of two Slug ships in communication range. They don't see you.

choice.name: c:slug-comm-tapping:0
choice.effect: You overhear their conversation and learn they're planning to raid an infamous and likely wealthy pirate ship in the area. The pair jump off and you note down their target co-ordinates.

eventBlueprint.name: engi-fleet-discussion
eventBlueprint.title: Engi fleet discussion
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive near a small fleet of civilian Engi ships. A simple decryption and translation of their comm frequency tells you that they are having a frantic discussion about something obviously troubling them.

choice.name: c:engi-fleet-discussion:0
choice.text: Message them and ask if you can help.
choice.effect: They decline.

choice.name: c:engi-fleet-discussion:2
choice.text: Have your Engi crewmember contact them.
choice.effect: Two quest markers are added to your map.

eventBlueprint.name: ancient-device
eventBlueprint.title: Ancient device
eventBlueprint.text: An ancient device is orbiting within the crystal rings of a nearby gas giant. You can't discern its nature or function, but it seems to have been deactivated for a very long time. Perhaps you can get some scrap from it.

choice.name: c:ancient-device:0
choice.effect: You break it apart, or a Rock military ship answers.

choice.name: c:ancient-device:2
choice.effect: The device opens a wormhole.

eventBlueprint.name: rock-war-vessel-encounter
eventBlueprint.title: Rock war vessel encounter
eventBlueprint.text: You are immediately messaged by an imposing looking Rock war vessel, "You're the ship off to 'save the Federation,' aren't you? And you expect to survive with that hunk of junk?"

choice.name: c:rock-war-vessel-encounter:0
choice.text: "We're going to save them or die trying."
choice.effect: "The latter being more likely. Still... we can potentially help you and your precious fleet, but you'll need to prove yourself first. Meet us at these coordinates." They jump away.

choice.name: c:rock-war-vessel-encounter:1
choice.effect: "One ship is not the same as a fleet, but at least you've got some fire. Meet us at these coordinates if you want to prove to us that the Federation is worth saving." They jump away.

eventBlueprint.name: unarmed-zoltan-transport
eventBlueprint.title: Unarmed Zoltan transport
eventBlueprint.text: An unarmed Zoltan transport vessel is slowly making its way toward the beacon here. They hail: "This is a Zoltan peace envoy. We carry no weapons or shielding and rely on the mercy of others to communicate our message."

choice.name: c:unarmed-zoltan-transport:1
choice.effect:
They continue. "We take your silence for interested contemplation." They talk at length about peace and harmony, but either it's beyond your simple mind or it's all nonsense.
They finish: "Please, spread the word of enlightenment to those that have not heard. Once you have, contact our brethren." They transmit coordinates of their so-called "brethren".

eventBlueprint.name: zoltan-research-facility
eventBlueprint.title: Zoltan research facility
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive at a Zoltan research facility. They say they are researching genetic distortion due to stasis sleep and prolonged FTL travel. They ask if your crew has the time to undergo a few scans.

choice.name: c:zoltan-research-facility:0
choice.effect: The Zoltans take their readings.

choice.name: c:zoltan-research-facility:2
choice.effect: They pay for the data.

choice.name: c:zoltan-research-facility:3
choice.text: Ask if they can fix this.
choice.effect:
"Interesting. I've never seen a cryogenic system like this. It appears to still be functioning..." They hook it up to their system and run a number of tests on it.
"Amazing! It has the ability to reconstruct the body if it was damaged during transit. Watch." They reactivate the pod and you watch as the hunks of crystal inside reform to build a humanoid structure. The pod slides open and the re-formed alien steps out.
It speaks slowly, "Greetings. I appear to be in your debt. My people isolated themselves a long time ago, but perhaps it's time to re-establish a connection. There's a hidden wormhole near the Rock home-worlds. Perhaps you can take me there so I can properly repay you?"

eventBlueprint.name: zoltan-trade-hub
eventBlueprint.title: Zoltan trade hub
eventBlueprint.text: You come to a Zoltan trade and supply hub - everything the weary traveler needs, provided they have the right documentation.

choice.name: c:zoltan-trade-hub:0
choice.text: Try to talk your way in.
choice.effect: You try your luck at the airlock.

choice.name: c:zoltan-trade-hub:1
choice.text: Beam directly to the civilian deck.
choice.effect: In the Zoltan hub.

choice.name: c:zoltan-trade-hub:2
choice.text: Present his official documentation and pay the entry fee.

eventBlueprint.name: rock-bride
eventBlueprint.title: Rock bride
eventBlueprint.text: A rock captain hails you: "It is improper of me to contact off-worlders, but this is an emergency. We were on our way to deliver our passenger to her new husband - the Grand Basilisk of Numa V - when our engines broke down. Will you take possession of her, and make haste to Numa V?"

choice.name: c:rock-bride:0
choice.effect: "You surprise me, off-worlder. Thank you. The passenger will be with you momentarily." She refuses to enter the main hold and prefers to wait in the cargo bay.

eventBlueprint.name: asteroid-belt-distress
eventBlueprint.title: Asteroid belt distress
eventBlueprint.text: You follow the distress beacon to a tiny asteroid belt. You find a small ship struggling to maneuver through the field.

choice.name: c:asteroid-belt-distress:0
choice.effect: They beg for help.

eventBlueprint.name: capture-the-ship
eventBlueprint.title: Capture the ship
eventBlueprint.text:
You arrive to find a number of ships convening around a station. There is some unencrypted chatter between the ships, you tune in and listen for anything interesting.
Overhearing their conversation, it seems that they need to take possession of an enemy ship intact.

choice.name: c:capture-the-ship:0
choice.effect: They decline.

choice.name: c:capture-the-ship:2
choice.effect: They hear your offer.

choice.name: c:capture-the-ship:3
choice.text: Offer to burn the crew out.
choice.effect: They hear your offer.

choice.name: c:capture-the-ship:4
choice.effect: They hear your offer.

eventBlueprint.name: encrypted-federation-signal
eventBlueprint.title: Encrypted federation signal
eventBlueprint.text: A Federation encrypted signal is being broadcast from a nearby planet.

choice.name: c:encrypted-federation-signal:0
choice.text: Send an away party to investigate.
choice.effect: The away party reports back.

choice.name: c:encrypted-federation-signal:1
choice.text: It could be a trap, let's move on.

eventBlueprint.name: engi-ship-attacked-by-mantis-ship
eventBlueprint.title: Engi ship attacked by Mantis ship
eventBlueprint.alias: Engi ship attacked by Mantis ship
Engi Ship Attacked by Mantis Ship
eventBlueprint.text: You receive a distress call from a nearby Engi ship. "Assistance requested. Danger present. Imminent destruction."

choice.name: c:engi-ship-attacked-by-mantis-ship:0
choice.text: Respond to the call and move in to assist.
choice.effect: You move in.

eventBlueprint.name: merchant-s-request
eventBlueprint.title: Merchant's request
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive at a populated sector. One merchant seems to be mass-broadcasting a request for a mercenary ship to aid him. Shall we respond?

choice.name: c:merchant-s-request:0
choice.effect: The merchant explains.

eventBlueprint.name: nebula-wreckage
eventBlueprint.title: Nebula wreckage
eventBlueprint.text: This nebula looks like it's recently seen two ships exchange fire... with mutually-assured destructive results. Wreckage drifts by your screens and tumbles into the depths of the nebula to be lost to sight. It's hard to determine who the combatants were without closer investigation.

choice.name: c:nebula-wreckage:0
choice.text: Ask your Slug crew to scan for survivors.
choice.effect: Your Slug finds a survivor.

choice.name: c:nebula-wreckage:1
choice.effect: You search the wreckage.

choice.name: c:nebula-wreckage:2
choice.text: Leave the battlefield before other ships arrive.

eventBlueprint.name: crystal-chat
eventBlueprint.title: Crystal chat
eventBlueprint.text: A small civilian vessel messages you, "Wow! You're that alien that opened up the portal, aren't you! Are you busy? Can I ask you a question?"

choice.name: c:crystal-chat:crystal
choice.text: Have your crew speak to them.

eventBlueprint.name: crystalline-cache
eventBlueprint.title: Crystalline cache
eventBlueprint.text: Odd radar pings from a huge, orbiting asteroid here reveal a Crystalline cache of some kind. A deep crater has been sealed over with a thick layer of crystal to keep whatever's inside safe — it'd take some serious firepower to break through.

choice.name: c:crystalline-cache:weapons
choice.text: Attempt to break through with the weapons you have.

choice.name: c:crystalline-cache:crystal
choice.text: Have your Crystalline Being recalibrate your weapons.

eventBlueprint.name: crystalline-men-buried
eventBlueprint.title: Crystalline men buried
eventBlueprint.text: A large Crystalline ship is floating in space here. They hail: "Aliens?! How curious. We request your aid. We have men buried on a nearby planet and we must dig them out."

eventBlueprint.name: crystalline-research-facility
eventBlueprint.title: Crystalline research facility
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive near what appears to be a Crystalline research facility. A scientist quickly messages you, "Ah! You're those aliens! Please, I've heard so much about you and I'm curious about your physiology! Would you let us run a few simple tests?"

choice.name: c:crystalline-research-facility:allow
choice.text: Allow them to run tests on a crew member.

eventBlueprint.name: engi-research-station
eventBlueprint.title: Engi research station
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive at a smoldering Engi research station, its distress call unanswered — attacked by pirates or Mantis most likely. There may be someone left alive, or else something of value left on board.

choice.name: c:free-scrap-with-resources-engi:take
choice.text: You receive a random amount of scrap with resources.

eventBlueprint.name: free-scrap-with-resources-zoltan
eventBlueprint.title: Free scrap with resources (Zoltan)
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive to find a lumbering Zoltan freighter with no one at the helm. It's a mystery what happened to the crew, but it'd be a shame to let the opportunity go to waste.

choice.name: c:free-scrap-with-resources-zoltan:take
choice.text: You receive a random amount of scrap with resources.

eventBlueprint.name: zoltan-free-map
eventBlueprint.title: Zoltan free map
eventBlueprint.text:
The Zoltan stationed near this beacon are happy to receive you. As they give you the formal tour of their ship you spy some local star charts and mentally log the details.
The current sector map is revealed.

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-empty-distress-beacon-1
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius empty distress beacon 1
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive at the location of the distress signal prepared for a fight, but on first glance it's entirely empty. The signal is coming from a small plastic satellite orbiting a moon. A looping message describes how settlers have recently abandoned the area due to the Lanius threat. You fail to find any other signs of a settlement nearby.

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-empty-distress-beacon-2
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius empty distress beacon 2
eventBlueprint.text: When you get to the beacon you quickly try to locate the source of the distress call. As you are looking, the signal blinks out. It is then that you notice the small fleet of scavenger ships absorbing debris from a large battle nearby. You can't help but wonder where the distress signal came from, but you decide not to risk pressuring the fleet.

eventBlueprint.name: lanius-with-federation-science-craft
eventBlueprint.title: Lanius with Federation science craft
eventBlueprint.text: A Federation science craft is docked with a few Lanius ships. You hail them and ask what is going on. "Greetings! We have been attempting to understand our region's newest visitors, the Lanius, although we have been making little headway in deciphering their language."

choice.name: c:lanius-with-federation-science-craft:ask
choice.text: Ask if they have anything that could help your mission.

choice.name: c:lanius-with-federation-science-craft:lanius
choice.text: Offer to copy your translator's data suite.

eventBlueprint.name: slug-oxygen-malfunction
eventBlueprint.title: Slug oxygen malfunction
eventBlueprint.text: You find a Slug vessel broadcasting a distress signal and contact them. "Ah, yesss, we are having problems with our oxygen generation unit. Perhaps your crew can assist in repairsss?"

choice.name: c:slug-oxygen-malfunction:mantis
choice.text: Have your Mantis oversee the repairs.

eventBlueprint.name: slug-repair-station
eventBlueprint.title: Slug repair station
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive to find a small Slug repair station. "Greetingsss traveller! Care for a fix up? We could eassily patch up ssome of that damage."

choice.name: c:slug-repair-station:pay
choice.text: Ask if they would like payment.

eventBlueprint.name: slug-store-ship
eventBlueprint.title: Slug store ship
eventBlueprint.text: A Slug transport ship is stationed near the beacon with a military escort ship. They message you, "We have been waiting for a customer for agesss. Care to see our waresss?"

eventBlueprint.name: slug-and-rock-standoff-in-nebula
eventBlueprint.title: Slug and Rock standoff in nebula
eventBlueprint.alias: Slug and Rock standoff in nebula
eventBlueprint.text: You detect multiple ships running at maximum power nearby, but you can't see anything through this thick nebula.

eventBlueprint.name: arrive-mantis-chase
eventBlueprint.title: Mantis trail
eventBlueprint.text:
You catch up with the Mantis ship that escaped before, only to see them transferring their crew into an even bigger ship!
"Not YOU again! Do you know how much these repairs are going to cost me? Time to take out the big guns."

eventBlueprint.name: arrive-slug-pirate-trap
eventBlueprint.title: Slug raid
eventBlueprint.text:
You catch up with the two Slug ships and they're already carrying out their raid! One is in close combat with the pirate, the other seems to be heading for a small space cache the pirate was protecting.
Suddenly the first ship bursts into flames, and an urgent call arrives from the remaining Slugs. "We sssugest you distract the pirate vesssel while we retrieve the valuables. Fifty fifty sssplit."

eventBlueprint.name: arrive-engi-real
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel base
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive at one of the Rebel bases that the Engi told you about. It appears abandoned except for one scout ship. Perhaps you could extract information from them.

eventBlueprint.name: arrive-engi-fake
eventBlueprint.title: Rebel base
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive at one of the Rebel bases that the Engi told you about. It appears abandoned except for one scout ship. Perhaps you could extract information from them.

eventBlueprint.name: arrive-engi-final
eventBlueprint.title: Mantis convoy
eventBlueprint.text: You have finally caught up with the ships you've been hunting. A hangar-sized cargo ship is being escorted by a number of Mantis ships. As you reconsider the assault, a squadron of Engi ships with pirate emblems jump in and assist you. You prepare to fight the Mantis but scans indicate they are manned by Rebels!

eventBlueprint.name: arrive-slug-platform
eventBlueprint.title: Construction platform
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive to discover an impressive cruiser being worked on by a few smaller ships and guarded by an assault ship. The mobile construction platform is slowly slipping into the clouds. You have not yet been noticed.

choice.name: q:slug-platform:tail
choice.text: Try to tail them without being noticed.

eventBlueprint.name: arrive-store-rescue
eventBlueprint.title: Space dock
eventBlueprint.text: Once you arrive at the beacon you detect a Rebel scout assaulting a compound on a nearby desolate moon.

choice.name: q:store-rescue:engage
choice.text: Engage the Rebel and rescue the space dock.

eventBlueprint.name: arrive-rock-sun
eventBlueprint.title: Red giant
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive at the coordinates given and find yourself dangerously close to an M-class star! The other ship messages you, "Let's see how long your puny ship can handle this heat! Prepare for a challenge!"

eventBlueprint.name: arrive-zoltan-peace
eventBlueprint.title: Zoltan brethren
eventBlueprint.text: You arrive at the location specified by the peace-loving Zoltan, but the only thing nearby is a Rebel ship, closing in fast! "We've found you! You're not getting away this time!"

eventBlueprint.name: arrive-rock-bride
eventBlueprint.title: Numa V
eventBlueprint.text:
A vast tunnel network near the surface of Numa V indicates an advanced Rock civilization. This must be where you were asked to deliver the passenger.
Realizing arrival is imminent, your passenger - silent so far - pleads with you not to hand her over. She's interrupted by the Grand Basilisk's Chief Aide: "To the alien vessel holding the Basilisk's wife. Deliver her to us. You will be rewarded... well."

eventBlueprint.name: arrive-zoltan-primitives
eventBlueprint.title: Primitive planet
eventBlueprint.text:
You arrive at the primitive planet that you heard about at the cantina and are surprised to see a Zoltan ship facing off against a Rebel assault craft.
You tap into their frequency and hear the Rebel captain yelling, "We are liberating this planet in the name of the new Galactic government! These aliens will not be left in ignorance where they cannot be of use!"

choice.name: c:zoltan-quest-primitives:0
choice.text: Interfere - make first contact with the primitive aliens

choice.name: c:zoltan-quest-primitives:1
choice.text: Protect the aliens' way of life - Attack the Rebel ship

eventBlueprint.name: arrive-capture-ship
eventBlueprint.title: Bandit ship
eventBlueprint.text: You find the ship that you were asked to capture intact. You're not sure why, but they stressed that it's of great importance that you kill the crew WITHOUT destroying the ship.

choice.name: s:slug-home-nebula-surrender:info
choice.text: Let them live. We don't want the weapon, we want information.
choice.effect: You ask where they were delivering the weapon. "By telling you we will probably die jussst as like as not... Oh well." They give you the coordinates of the a prototype cruiser's mobile construction platform.

choice.name: q:capture:agree
choice.effect: "Great, we'll relay their coordinates. Remember, do NOT destroy that ship! Remember, we'll be right behind you."

choice.name: q:merchant:investigate
choice.effect: "At least you're confident, for what little that's worth. Here is their last known location."

choice.name: q:nebula:comfort
choice.text: Make them comfortable for their final moments.
choice.effect: On their death bed, they croak out a series of coordinates and beg you to go there - when you attempt to ask them why, the survivor simply says, "ABADOTH" and perishes.

choice.name: q:mantis-collectors:follow
choice.effect: You input their coordinates into your map and prepare to follow.
